00045 FSinOscUGenInternal::FSinOscUGenInternal(UGen const& freq, const float initialPhase, const int channel) throw()
00046 :   UGenInternal(NumInputs),
00047     currentFreq(0.0),
00048     b1(0.0),
00049     y1(0.0),
00050     y2(0.0)
00051 {
00052     inputs[Freq] = freq;
00053     
00054     if(inputs[Freq].isScalar(channel))
00055         currentFreq = inputs[Freq].getValue(channel);
00056     
00057     double w = currentFreq * twopi * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00058     b1 = 2. * std::cos(w);
00059     y1 = std::sin(initialPhase);
00060     y2 = std::sin(initialPhase-w);
00061 }
00062 
00063 UGenInternal* FSinOscUGenInternal::getChannel(const int channel) throw()
00064 {   
00065     return new FSinOscUGenInternal((float)currentFreq, 0.f, channel);
00066 }

00073 void FSinOscUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00074 {   
00075     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00076     float newFreq = *(inputs[Freq].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel));
00077     double y0;
00078     
00079     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, b1);
00080     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, y1);
00081     LOCAL_DECLARE(double, y2);
00082     
00083     if(newFreq != currentFreq)
00084     {
00085         currentFreq = newFreq;
00086         
00087         double initialPhase;
00088         
00089         if((1.0-std::abs(y1)) < 0.00001)
00090         {
00091             initialPhase = y1 > 0.0 ? pi2 : -pi2;
00092         }
00093         else
00094         {
00095             initialPhase = std::asin(y1);
00096             // based on the trajectory predict which solution of asin(y1) is correct..
00097             if(y2 >= y1)
00098             {
00099                 double piVersion = y1 > 0.0 ? pi : -pi;         
00100                 initialPhase = piVersion - initialPhase;
00101             }
00102         }
00103 
00104         double w = currentFreq * twopi * UGen::getReciprocalSampleRate();
00105         b1 = zap(2. * std::cos(w));
00106         y1 = zap(std::sin(initialPhase));
00107         y2 = zap(std::sin(initialPhase-w));
00108     }
00109     
00110     int filterLoops = UGen::getFilterLoops();
00111     while(filterLoops--)
00112     {
00113         y0 = b1 * y1 - y2;
00114         *outputSamples++ = y0;
00115         y2 = b1 * y0 - y1;
00116         *outputSamples++ = y2; 
00117         y1 = b1 * y2 - y0;
00118         *outputSamples++ = y1; 
00119     }
00120     
00121     int filterRemain = UGen::getFilterRemain();
00122     while(filterRemain--)
00123     {
00124         y0 = b1 * y1 - y2;
00125         *outputSamples++ = y0; 
00126         y2 = y1; 
00127         y1 = y0;
00128     }
00129     
00130 //  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00131 //  for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)
00132 //  {
00133 //      y0 = b1 * y1 - y2;
00134 //      outputSamples[i] = y0;// = b1 * y1 - y2; 
00135 //      y2 = y1; 
00136 //      y1 = y0;
00137 //  }
00138         
00139     y1 = zap(y1);
00140     y2 = zap(y2);
00141     LOCAL_COPY(b1);
00142     LOCAL_COPY(y1);
00143     LOCAL_COPY(y2);
00144 }
